data.desc: Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. is one of the world's leading car rental and mobility solutions providers. Its subsidiaries, including The Hertz Corporation , and licensees operate the Hertz , Dollar, Thrifty, and Firefly vehicle rental brands, with approximately 11,000 rental locations in 160 countries around the globe. The Company also operates the Hertz Car Sales brand, which offers a range of quality, competitively priced used cars for sale online and at locations across the United States , and the Hertz 24/7 car-sharing business in Europe . The Company holds a majority stake in Oro, which provides integrated fleet management solutions across both driver-led and autonomous segments. For more information about Hertz , visit www.hertz.com .
